newsitem.title: USA: TCSI Corp falls on Q3 earnings concern.
newsitem.headline: TCSI Corp falls on Q3 earnings concern.

text.p: Shares of TCSI Corp, a maker of communications software principally for telephone companies, was off 5-1/2 to 15-1/4 in late afternoon on market talk the company would not meet third quarter earnings expectations.
"It's definitely concern about the third quarter," said John Stanley, analyst at Maryland-based Newby and Co.
TCSI officials were unavailable. Analysts call for it to earn $0.14 a share in the quarter, according to First Call.
Newby said the company typically sells high-margin products to only a few companies, principally the regional Bell operating companies who sometimes delay summer orders.
He also noted today's decline likely has been exacerbated by several large block trades as high as 450,000 shares.
